# All Posts

::: {#gallery-latest}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
window.addEventListener("load", function () {
  const query = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("filter");
  const list = window["quarto-listings"] && window["quarto-listings"]["listing-gallery-latest"];
  const input = document.querySelector(".quarto-listing-filter input.search");
  if (!query || !list || !input) return;
  input.value = query;
  list.search(query);
});
</script>
```
